Alex (Support): Customer 'acme-retail' reporting failures when using JSON mode "strict" for batch order ingestion. Root ts: 2485550011.
Alex (Support): API returned: "JSON parse error: unexpected extra key 'temp_id' in items[1]". Correlation rpc=ci-9f2b. Observed latency ~1187ms then client retried -> double billing.
Alex (Support): Sample request we sent:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-2","json_mode":"strict","input":{"items":[{"id":"a1","qty":2},{"temp_id":"x-3","qty":1},{"id":"a3","qty":null}]}}'
```
Maria (ML Eng): Can you paste exact response body + headers and which deploy/revision? Streaming on/off?
Alex (Support): Response body: {"error":"parse_error","message":"unexpected key 'temp_id' at items[1]","request_id":"req-01cb"} Headers: x-request-id:req-01cb x-latency-ms:1187 x-auth-ttl:45
Jules (SRE): Looks like model (or prompt template) sometimes emits a transient "temp_id" field in items. Our strict validator fails. Client-side retries after ~1.2s caused duplicate requests.
Tess (Billing): We need all request_ids (both calls) to check double-charge and refund.
Alex (Support): Customer logs show two request_ids: req-01cb and req-01cc. Both billed.
Maria (ML Eng): Repro checklist: exact prompt, model & rev, deploy flags (streaming, quantization), and full server trace for req-01cb.
Alex (Support): Server trace (sanitized): "trace:" "model_resp:{items:[{id:'a1',qty:2},{temp_id:'x-3',qty:1}]}". Also saw occasional 401 after client retry — x-auth-ttl is small (45s) so token expired between attempts.
Jules (SRE): Short-term mitigation: flip this workspace to json_mode:"tolerant" so unknown keys are ignored/mapped, and recommend client stop aggressive retries. Add Idempotency-Key header to client to dedupe.
Tess (Billing): Once Alex provides both request_ids we will refund duplicates and flag account for review. Also propose a billing rule to detect rapid identical requests and auto-flag.
Maria (ML Eng): Long-term plan: 1) Add response-sanitizer to drop unknown keys for structured output. 2) Implement per-workspace schema relaxation flags. 3) Add middleware to de-dupe rapid retries before billing.
Alex (Support): Customer accepted temporary tolerant mode. Action items: Maria to attempt reproduce with provided payload (EOD), Jules to add token TTL alert + update retry guidance, Tess to process refunds after Alex provides final list of request ids.
Maria (ML Eng): I'll repro against gpt-open-2@rev-2025-10, run targeted fuzzing to measure how often "temp_id" appears. If reproducible, we'll patch sanitizer and canary the fix.
Alex (Support): Thanks all — I'll update the customer and attach logs. :thumbsup:
